description: This file defines classes and data structures related to event handling in the firmware, specifically for injection and ignition events, including initialization and utility methods.

classes.name: InjectionEvent
classes.description: Represents an injection event with properties indicating timing, overlapping, and related outputs.

classes.name: event_trigger_position_s
classes.description: Stores trigger position details such as event index, angle, and offset.

classes.name: IgnitionEvent
classes.description: Represents an ignition event with timing, output, and cylinder information.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Represents an output pin for ignition control, used in ignition event outputs.

methods.name: getOutputForLoggins
methods.description: Returns the primary output pin for logging purposes in ignition events.
